setOptimization.policy: low-attack-v2: no Physical move, Hidden Power or external move access; minimum Attack DV preserving HP and shiny status; Attack EV 0; conditional female preference except own Attract users and multi-variant camouflage clusters

femalePreference.basis: female targets resist female sources and are susceptible to male sources; weighted direct-source-set mass is a proxy, not encounter or win probability

setOptimization.scoreBasis: confirmation scores refer to the original inventory/evolved sets, before low-attack-v2; optimized sets have not been remeasured

drawRule: each variant cluster among the selected parties is drawn with equal probability, split equally among its members (drawWeight sums to 1); the same weights serve the human Random and the bot draw
